about: Published questions, paraphrases of each (should match it), and queries that should match none: off-topic ones and, harder, questions on the same topics that were not published. Used by scripts/answer_threshold.py to set how close a visitor's query must be to a published question before its answer is shown (docs/STATIC_SEARCH.md, Answers written in advance).
